{{Quote|Dulok shaman? Pah! Old fakir! What do you want here?|[[Morag]]|<ref name="The Cries of the Trees">{{Ewoks|The Cries of the Trees}}</ref>}}
'''Umwak''' was a [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] from the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Serving as the religious leader of the Dulok band ruled by King [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]], he sometimes had dealings with the Dulok oracle [[Murgoob]], and [[Morag]], the [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] witch. Umwak had scraggly, green fur; long, droopy ears, and fangs extending from his lower jaw. He had yellow markings on his snout and belly and around his right eye. He wore no clothing, although he did sport jewelry such as an earring, a bone hairpiece, and a bone necklace. Umwak walked with a stooped gait, balancing on his skull-topped wooden staff. Umwak hated the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], and he often hatched intricate schemes against them. He also had a [[Umwak's nephew|nephew]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Joe ''[Johnston]'' killed off their leader, so rather than try to revive him when I did the Ewok development, I created three new Duloks and made them the leaders.|''Ewoks'' associate producer and story editor Paul Dini in 1988|<ref name="Starlog">[[Starlog (magazine)|''Starlog'']], Yearbook 3</ref>}}
In the [[Ewoks: Season One|first season]] of [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] cartoon, Umwak is voiced by [[Don Francks]]. In 1985, [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] released an Umwak action figure under the name "Dulok Shaman".
